ruling: Owner instruction 2026-09-07, verbatim: "Leave the 2023 results be as they are under a different config. Promote the combined result of 2021-22-24-25 along with the 23 config as a single run on the dashboards. 23 was an outlier year with weird market design." Extends the 2026-08-26 two-config partition to five years.

2021.source_run: ercot-255 re-solve of the ercot253 2021 rung recipe

2022.source_run: ercot-255 re-solve of the ercot252 2022 rung recipe

2024.source_run: ercot-255 re-solve of the ercot248 forward config

2025.source_run: ercot-255 re-solve of the ercot248 forward config

mechanism: ercot_zonal_spread_ep_referenced ARMED in 2021/2022/2024/2025 and ABSENT in 2023, which is the owner instruction to leave the 2023 results as registered. The asymmetry is immaterial by measurement, not by assertion: the mechanism's 2023 footprint is 0.0020 $/MMBtu (0.015 $/MWh at CC hr 7.29) because ep_basis(2023) = +0.0045, a property of the measured input and not of the config.
composition: zero-extra-solve; hourly/*_<year>.parquet and the payload year block are taken from the bundle that solved that year. 2023 is copied byte-for-byte from ercot248_two_config_keeper (itself ercot236_k33_clip). meta.json / run_config.json carry the FORWARD config; run_config_carveout_2021_2022.json and run_config_carveout_2023.json carry the other two.
